text:
sam: Quick heads-up — noticed intermittent quality spikes after we soft-rolled AWQ group_size bump to 16 on canary yesterday.
ada: Saw that too. Short eval on our prompt set shows EM down ~1.8% vs FP16, and a weird pattern of hallucinations on long-context cases.
jordan: Did you bump act-quant params as well or just group_size?
sam: Just group_size=16 + default act quant. No other changes. Canary logs show increased sampling entropy around token 120-150.
evan: Posting the small perf snippet from canary run:
```
model: red-model-v2-awq
config: group_size=16, act_quant=true
squad_em: 76.2 (fp16 baseline 78.0)
perplexity: 23.5 (+3.2 vs fp16)
99pct_lat: 210ms
```
ada: Hmm. Could be group aggregation noise amplifying act quant rounding in deeper layers. Any correlation with KV cache splits?
sam: KV splits unchanged. Also saw occasional decode hangs for ~200ms then resumed.
ml-ci-bot: CI: eval-run/3246801201 finished — regression detected on long-form tests. Full diffs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/reports/3246801201
jordan: Can you run a targeted sweep: group_size 8/12/16, act_quant true/false, seed 42/99. Low-cost eval on 500 prompts should reveal trend.
ada: I'll queue it on staging now and include the prefix-cache disabled run.
sam: For triage: plan is (1) repro on staging with deterministic seeds, (2) run layer-wise act-quant ablations, (3) if repro, roll back to group_size=8 and re-run canary.
evan: If this is non-deterministic, we should capture kv cache dumps around token 100-160. I can add a lite trace.
jordan: Also add the fudge test: run with stochastic sampling turned off (greedy) to see if sampling amplifies errors.
sam: Agree. I'll open a tiny PR to flip group_size back if sweep shows consistent delta. @ada @jordan loop me in on results.
ada: queued jobs: staging-sweep-3246801300 (gs 8/12/16 x actq true/false x seeds 42/99). ETA ~45m.
jordan: If we find it's act-quant interaction, we might try softer quant scale for first 8 layers as a mitigation.
sam: Thanks. I'll watch the CI report and revert if >1% EM drop holds across seeds. :thumbsup:
